notes: PrefLib file 00030-00000001.soi (dataset 00030, 'uklabor'). Counting rule, as far as we know: Alternative vote (instant runoff) by electoral college; these are only the 266 MPs' ballots.

label_sources.date: Result announced 25 September 2010 (Wikipedia, "2010 Labour Party leadership election (UK)").

label_notes: These are only the 266 MPs' ballots, one third of an electoral college. The official winner (Ed Miliband) won the whole college, not this section, so official_winners is null.
